descriptor.scene: A CIRCLE OF BUILDERS AROUND A TABLE is the subject, eight people filling the frame. Desks have been pushed into a rough ring under warm lamps, night behind the windows. MAYA in her sage-olive blazer sets a small device on the table. CHRISSY, blonde hair down, cream blazer, leans forward on her elbows grinning. The ENGINEER in his charcoal zip hoodie and rounded dark glasses turns a laptop to face the others. GARY sits among them, denim jacket with the yellow smiley patch on the left chest and the orange pixel-mascot patch on the right chest, listening. Four more founders fill out the circle, seated and perched on desk edges. Mugs, cables, pizza boxes at the edge. Everything on the table is mid-demonstration, nothing staged. Keep the lower-right corner calm.
descriptor._caption: Every Thursday the room fills with founders. They do not come to watch a presentation. They bring what they built that week, and what broke, and what shocked them, and they put it on the table.
descriptor.anonymous: four more founders of varied builds and skin tones filling out the circle, seated and perched on desk edges
